name_en: Maintenance Allowance for Differently Abled Persons
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: You get Rs 1,500 every month. The money goes straight into your bank account from the Treasury. It is for four groups: people with intellectual disability, people with severe disability, people with muscular dystrophy, and people affected by leprosy.

other: Severe disability: more than 75% disability, and no other scheme can help you.
Leprosy: 40% deformity or more, and you live in a Government Rehabilitation Home.

documents: National identity card for differently abled persons
For leprosy: a doctor's certificate that surgery or other treatment cannot cure you
how_to_apply: Get the form from the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer. Fill it and give it back with your papers.
where_to_apply: District Differently Abled Welfare Office in your district

evidence.quote: Maintenance allowance is given at the rate of Rs.1,500/- per month to the intellectually disabled persons with 40 percentage of disability and above.
The allowance is sent through “ECS” to bank account of individual directly from Treasury.
Maintenance allowance is given at the rate of Rs.1,500/- per month to the severely affected persons
Maintenance allowance is given at the rate of Rs.1,500/- per month to the person affected with muscular dystrophy.
Maintenance allowance is given at the rate of Rs. 1,500/- per month to leprosy affected persons.
The percentage of disability should be more than 75%. Locomotor disabled persons who cannot be rehabilitated through any other scheme.
Persons should be affected with muscular dystrophy and percentage of disability 40% and above.
Leprosy affected with deformity of 40% and above.
The inmates accommodated in the Government Rehabilitation Homes are eligible to receive this allowance
National identity card for differently abled, Family card and Bank account details.
A certificate from doctor stating that the applicant is not curable by surgical/other means
Prescribed format is available with District Differently Abled Welfare Officer.

Officer to whom the application is to be submitted
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer
